_comment: Scoring rubrics. Topics only — the judges keep the full rubric sheet in front
of them; this is where the points land.
Team Interview below is taken exactly from the official Team Interview Rubric
v2.0: six criteria, 0-2 points each, 12 total.
The notebook PDF supplied was the blank Digital Notebook Template teams fill
in, not a scoring rubric, so these topics are a stand-in. Replace the criteria
below with the ones on your real notebook rubric and reload the page — nothing
else needs changing. Delete "placeholder": true once you have.

sections.name: Record Keeping
criteria: Entries are dated and in order
Entries are the students' own work
Drawings and data support the writing

sections.name: Explain Your Learning
criteria: Students trace how they got there
Students show how they know it works

sections.name: How You Worked with Others
criteria: Students learned from and with each other
Outside ideas were made their own
